import requests, json, sys

BASE = 'http://localhost:5000'

def test(name, method, path, data=None, expected_status=200):
    r = getattr(requests, method)(BASE + path, json=data, timeout=5)
    ok = r.status_code == expected_status
    print(f"{'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'} {method.upper()} {path} -> {r.status_code}")
    if not ok:
        print(f"  Expected {expected_status}, got {r.status_code}: {r.text[:100]}")
    return r.json() if r.text else None

print('Testing TODO API...')
print()

# Create
todo = test('create', 'post', '/todos', {'title': 'Buy milk'}, 201)
print(f"  Created: {json.dumps(todo)}")

# List
todos = test('list', 'get', '/todos')
print(f"  Count: {len(todos)}")

# Get
test('get', 'get', f"/todos/{todo['id']}")

# Update
updated = test('update', 'patch', f"/todos/{todo['id']}", {'done': True})
print(f"  Done: {updated['done']}")

# Delete
test('delete', 'delete', f"/todos/{todo['id']}", expected_status=204)

# Verify deleted
test('verify_deleted', 'get', f"/todos/{todo['id']}", expected_status=404)

print()
print('All tests passed!')
